Moss's other two North notes mention Quarrendon but have no ticket numbers.

I also pointed out a conflict over #4419. Marcus Lindqvist's handoff note (14 Jul 2025, not one of Moss's) uses the same number for a printer delay at Gate 3, which doesn't match the scanner issue. My first message said the ticket folder might settle it. I then checked, and Dana can't see any Quarrendon account or ticket files, so I sent a short correction saying to confirm it with support instead.

I only used notes Dana can open herself (public North team files and Marcus's public note). The `search_messages` tool wasn't needed.
